hits.title: JetBrains-backed Kineto launches Kinetik AI agent for social media growth and monetisation | Dealroom.co
hits.snippet: JetBrains-backed Kineto launches Kinetik AI agent for social media growth and monetisation | Dealroom.co ... # JetBrains-backed Kineto launches Kinetik AI agent for social media growth and monetisation ... ● Jun 2026 ... Kineto, a startup backed by JetBrains, has launched Kinetik, an AI agent specialising in social media marketing and content strategy. The platform analyzes audience behavior, trends and content performance to help creators optimise engagement and monetise their social media presence. Operating within messaging apps like Slack, WhatsApp and Telegram, Kinetik connects to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X to provide personalised insights. The platform offers trend research, content analysis, video feedback and voice note transcription whilst learning users' brand voice and goals. Kinetik is available for individual creators and teams of up to 100 people, with subscription plans starting at $12.50. The company will demonstrate the platform at VidCon 2026 in Anaheim, California, later this month.
